item.subject: science
item.stem: In a pond near Meena's school in Nagpur, a food chain is observed: algae → small insects → small fish → large fish → heron. Meena says the large fish must be at the first trophic level because it is bigger and stronger than the other organisms. Which statement correctly assigns the trophic levels in this food chain?

options.A: The heron is at the first trophic level because it is the largest and strongest animal.
options.B: Trophic level is decided by body size, so the large fish is at a higher level than the heron.
options.C: The algae are at the first trophic level, the insects at the second, the small fish at the third, and the heron at the highest level.
options.D: All organisms in the pond are at the same trophic level because they live in the same habitat.
